Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) 
Placement Program Internship – Data Analytics (ACC)​
 
1. What is the Placement Program Internship? 
The Placement Program Internship is designed for students and freshers who have completed their 
course but are still not job-ready. It provides practical training, real work experience, mentorship, and 
interview preparation in an internship-style environment to help candidates develop industry-ready 
skills and improve their job placement opportunities.  
​
Why did we start this Placement Program Internship? 
We started this program because many students complete their courses and certifications but still 
struggle to get a job. The main reason is that most courses focus on learning concepts but provide 
limited real-world work experience and cannot guarantee placement. 
This does not mean the courses are bad; they provide valuable knowledge. However, employers often 
look for practical skills, work exposure, and job readiness. 
To bridge this gap, we launched the Placement Program Internship. It allows candidates to work with 
us in an internship-style environment, gain hands-on experience, develop industry-ready skills, and 
improve their chances of getting placed.

3. Is this a job guarantee program? 
No. We do not believe in making unrealistic job guarantee claims. No organization can genuinely 
guarantee a job because the final hiring decision always depends on the employer, candidate 
performance, interview results, and market conditions. 
Instead of offering false guarantees, we provide a strong commitment to support you throughout your 
job search journey. Our goal is to help you become job-ready and continue assisting you until you 
secure a suitable opportunity. 
What we provide:​
✅ 100% Placement Support​
✅ Continuous Job Assistance​
✅ Interview Preparation & Mock Interviews| Resume Building Support​
✅ Job Referrals & Opportunity Sharing | Mentorship and Career Guidance 
Our commitment is simple: we will continue to guide and support you in your placement journey until 
you get hired.

Q1. Is the General Data Analyst Internship free? 
It depends on the category you choose. 
🟢 Category 1 – Free Startup General Internship 
●​ Completely Free (No Joining Fee). 
●​ Available only for candidates with 80%+ practical knowledge who are willing to work in a 
startup environment and contribute across multiple business functions such as Data Analytics, 
HR, Marketing, Recruitment, Business Operations, Content Creation, and more. 
●​ Performance-based stipend opportunities may be available based on your contribution. 
🟡 Category 2 – Data Analytics Focused Internship 
●​ This category has a nominal internship fee because candidates choose to work primarily on 
Data Analytics with limited involvement in startup operations. 
●​ Tier 1 Cities: ₹3,000 
●​ Tier 2 & Tier 3 Cities: ₹2,000 
Q2. Who is eligible for the General Internship? 
Candidates should already possess 80%+ practical knowledge in Data Analytics and be capable of 
contributing to real company projects. 
Preferred skills include: 
●​ Python 
●​ Excel 
●​ SQL 
●​ Power BI 
●​ Web Scraping 
●​ Data Cleaning & Analysis 
●​ Dashboard Development 
●​ Minimum 10+ practical projects

Q3. What is the difference between Category 1 and Category 2? 
🟢 Category 1 – Free Startup Internship 
●​ Work on Data Analytics + Startup Operations. 
●​ Contribute to HR, Marketing, Recruitment, Business Operations, Content Creation, Research, 
Consulting, and other cross-functional activities. 
●​ No internship fee. 
🟡 Category 2 – Data Analytics Focused Internship 
●​ Focus mainly on Data Analytics projects. 
●​ Minimal involvement in HR, Marketing, Sales, or startup operational activities. 
●​ Internship fee applicable. 
Q4. Will I receive training during the internship? 
This is primarily a work-focused internship, not a classroom training program. 
●​ Candidates are expected to already have strong practical knowledge. 
●​ Basic onboarding, project guidance, mentorship, code reviews, and technical support will be 
provided whenever required. 
●​ Both Category candidates also receive structured OJT (On-the-Job Training) alongside project 
execution. 
Q5. Will I receive an Internship Certificate and Experience Letter? 
Yes. 
Candidates who successfully complete the internship, maintain good performance, and meet company 
expectations will receive: 
●​ Internship Certificate 
●​ Experience Letter 
●​ Project Experience 
●​ Professional Portfolio Support

Q6. Will I receive a stipend? 
The internship is not a fixed-stipend program. 
However, candidates who make exceptional contributions and create measurable value for the 
company may become eligible for performance-based stipend opportunities. 
Q7. Will I get placement support? 
Yes. 
Both categories receive placement support, including career guidance, resume support, interview 
preparation, and job opportunities based on eligibility and performance. 
Q8. What kind of candidates are selected? 
We look for candidates who: 
●​ Have 80%+ practical Data Analytics knowledge. 
●​ Can work on real business projects. 
●​ Take ownership and responsibility. 
●​ Have a startup mindset. 
●​ Learn quickly and solve problems independently. 
●​ Communicate effectively and collaborate with teams. 
●​ Are committed to continuous learning and professional growth. 
Q9. Why is there an internship fee for Category 2? 
Category 2 candidates choose to focus primarily on Data Analytics and contribute less to startup 
operations. The internship fee helps cover the company's investment in: 
●​ On-the-Job Training (OJT) 
●​ Mentorship 
●​ Real-Time Projects 
●​ Client Project Exposure 
●​ Project Reviews 
●​ Placement Support 
●​ Certificate & Experience Letter 
●​ Learning Resources and Company Infrastructure

Q1. Is this program free or paid? 
This is a paid program with a flexible payment structure. 
Program Fee: ₹5,000 
●​ ₹3,000 at the time of joining 
●​ ₹2,000 after securing a job 
Q2. Is your goal just to sell courses? 
Absolutely not. We strongly believe India's biggest problem is unemployment and lack of job 
readiness. Many institutions focus on selling courses, while we focus on helping candidates become 
job-ready through mentorship, practical exposure, and placement support. 
Q3. Is this program real or fake? 
ACC is an IT Services, EdTech, and Placement Support company is working to solve two major 
challenges: 
1.​ Affordable technology education. 
2.​ Reducing unemployment through job-readiness and placement support. 
Our founder, Wasim Patwari, has a mission to help 100,000 job seekers secure employment and make 
tech education more accessible and affordable. 
If you use common sense and review the problem we are solving, you'll find your answer—fake 
companies don't dedicate themselves to solving real unemployment and affordable education 
challenges.  
Q4. Do you guarantee a job? 
No. 
Please understand that "100% Job Guarantee" is often used as a marketing term in the industry. 
What we guarantee is: 
●​ Mentorship 
●​ Practical Guidance
